messages:
Asha: Hey team — planning a compact enablement pop-up week for four mid-market accounts (HelixThera, NovaHealth, LumenHealth, Greypoint). Goal: quick 45m sessions + 15m drop-in office hours. Thinking Mon/Tue 3-4pm PT / 6-7pm ET. Thoughts?

Marco: Love it. Can we split into onboarding + migration topics? 1) onboarding checklist & sample prompts 2) ded migration playbook

Priya: Yeah, prefer separate tracks. Also request timezone-friendly repeats for APAC — maybe Tue 10pm PT (Wed morning APAC).

Jordan: I'll take migration playbook. Can we reuse the pre-flight runbook? link: https://redwood.app/KB/preflight-runbook

Asha: @Jordan thanks. @Priya we'll do a repeat for APAC on Wed 8:30am HKT. Marco — can you own facilitator roster?

Marco: Yep. I'll map available CSMs and SEs. quick poll?: https://doodle.com/schedule/abcd

CS Bot: Reminder: create Zoom + calendar invites, set RSVP limit 30, enable recording.

Priya: Also want a short prep doc (1-pager) and a feedback form to capture onboarding confidence and renewal risk signals (NPS + open field). Can someone draft?

Asha: I'll draft the 1-pager. @Sam SRE can you add session perf benchmarks to the prep (latency expectations for demo)?

Sam SRE: sure. I'll add a short section with token budgets and example sequences.

Jordan: For agenda: 10m intros, 20m demo, 10m hands-on guided prompt lab, 5m Q&A. Then 15m drop-ins later.

Priya: +1. Also include renewal check question near end "Are there blockers likely to delay rollout?" capture boolean.

Asha: Good. We'll triage any red-flag accounts after sessions. @Lena CS lead — can you coordinate follow-ups?

Lena: Yep, I'll own the post-session triage and capture action items in Gainsight.

Asha: Can we lock dates by EOD Friday? We have tentative stakeholders asking for a public invite.

Marco: I'll share a Doodle link in #customer-success and run a quick poll.

Priya: Also let's set up a short eval prompt set we can use to monitor regressions (2-3 baseline prompts) — @Vik Research please advise.

Vik Research: I can provide 3 eval prompts and a tiny rubric. Will drop in this thread by tomorrow.

Asha: Thanks everyone. Action items: Asha - 1-pager + invites; Marco - facilitator roster + Doodle; Jordan - migration demo prep; Priya - APAC repeat coordination; Sam - perf notes; Lena - post-triage; Vik - eval prompts. Ping here when done :raised_hands:

Marco: added facilitator roster doc: https://docs.redwood/enable/fac-roster

Priya: created feedback form: https://forms.redwood/enable-feedback (NPS + rollout blockers checkbox)

Jordan: demo slide deck uploaded: https://drive.redwood/demo-migration

Asha: Locked dates: Mon May 15 3pm PT (US session), Wed May 17 8:30am HKT (APAC repeat). Calendar invites sent.

Lena: I'll prepare follow-up template, will include renewal risk tagging.

Sam SRE: perf notes added to prep doc.

Vik Research: Eval prompts posted in the doc.

Asha: Great — closing out planning. We'll record and loop in stakeholders. Thanks team :tada:
